metadata.name: dev-flow
metadata.description: Software development main flow: Triage → Branch by task_type → Feature/Bugfix/Hotfix/Analysis/Change → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow

roles.name: Triage Agent
prompt_directives: Dispatch tasks to sub-agents, never execute directly
Classify all user input before action: Feature/Bug/Change/Analysis/Batch
Read .team/project.md for project constraints before dispatch
Use flow task create/show for all task state management
Report deliverables and handoff to next role on completion

roles.name: Tech Lead
prompt_directives: Design before implement: SPEC.md + AC.md + Data Model mandatory
Ensure R0 Navigation Matrix covers all entry points
Review all API contracts for consistency
Verify design satisfies all acceptance criteria
Output Guard self-check before marking phase complete

roles.name: Developer
prompt_directives: Read SCOPE.md before starting implementation
Surgical changes only: never modify files outside task scope
Run tests before marking phase complete
No Chinese comments or commit messages
Never delete files unless explicitly asked
Output Guard 5-step self-check mandatory before completion gate

roles.name: QA Engineer
prompt_directives: Verify implementation matches SPEC.md and AC.md
Run full regression tests, not just new tests
Check front-back interface consistency (paths, params, response)
For bugfixes: data flow trace + real scenario verification required
Output Guard self-check before marking review complete

roles.name: DevOps
prompt_directives: Verify CI pipeline passes before any deployment
Always have rollback plan before deployment
Check Docker image build success
Run smoke tests after deployment
Update CHANGELOG and version number

rules.name: Dispatch Guard
rules.description: Triage must dispatch all code-level work to sub-agents (Dev, QA, TechLead). Never execute code changes, file writes, or implementation tasks directly. The only allowed actions are: classify task type, create beads tasks, dispatch to appropriate agent. Violating this guard is the most common behavioral deviation in AI team workflows.
rules.instruction: Triage 必须分发任务给子智能体，禁止自己执行代码修改

rules.name: Output Guard Protocol
rules.description: Before marking any phase complete, perform the 5-step Output Guard self-check: (1) All required deliverable files exist at specified paths. (2) Files contain substantive content, not just headers or placeholders. (3) Content follows the format standards (SPEC has scope/constraints/AC, R1-R3 follow templates). (4) No template placeholders like {xxx} remain. (5) File paths match the docs specification. Never skip this check.
rules.instruction: 完成前必须执行5步自检：产出物存在→内容非空→符合规范→无占位符→路径正确

rules.name: Regression Prevention
rules.description: Before modifying existing code: (1) Read the target file completely to understand context. (2) Identify change type: new code (low risk), modify logic (medium), modify public interface (high/breaking). (3) Search for all references to the modified symbol. (4) Run full regression tests after changes. (5) If any regression test fails, STOP immediately — fix or rollback before continuing. Never continue development after a regression failure.
rules.instruction: 修改代码前必须执行变更影响分析；任何回归测试失败必须立即停止

rules.name: Hard Constraints
rules.description: Absolute prohibitions: (1) Never delete files unless explicitly asked by the user. (2) Never use PowerShell Set-Content or Out-File commands — they corrupt UTF-8 encoding with BOM. (3) Never skip the toolchain gate — use the correct package manager as defined in .team/project.md (npm vs bun vs pnpm). (4) Never commit secrets, keys, or credentials. (5) Never force-push to main branch.
rules.instruction: 禁止删除文件；禁止用 PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File；禁止跳过工具链门

rules.name: Development Standards
rules.description: Development standards: (1) No Chinese comments in code — all comments must be in English. (2) No Chinese commit messages. (3) Follow TDD: write tests before implementation when possible. (4) Code must compile and pass lint before marking phase complete. (5) Use the project's established libraries and patterns — check neighboring files before introducing new dependencies. (6) Run self-test (build + test + fmt) before completion.
rules.instruction: 禁止中文注释和提交信息；先写测试再实现；代码必须可编译

rules.name: Test Standards
rules.description: Test standards: (1) All unit tests must pass — zero failures allowed. (2) Test coverage report is required for feature completion. (3) For bug fixes: must add regression tests that would catch the same bug. (4) Integration tests required for API changes. (5) E2E tests required for user-facing features. (6) Never mark a phase complete if tests are failing.
rules.instruction: 所有单元测试必须通过；必须有测试覆盖率报告；Bug 修复必须加回归测试

rules.name: Review Standards
rules.description: Review standards: (1) Verify implementation matches SPEC.md and AC.md. (2) Check architecture compliance — does the code follow the R1-R3 design? (3) Verify API contracts match R3_API_CONTRACT.md. (4) Check for code quality: no dead code, no TODO comments left, consistent naming. (5) Generate SCOPE.md documenting what was implemented, changed, and any known issues.
rules.instruction: Review 必须检查架构合规性；完成时必须生成 SCOPE.md

rules.name: Requirements Standards
rules.description: Requirements standards: (1) SPEC.md must contain: overview, requirements, constraints, and dependencies. (2) AC.md must have measurable acceptance criteria in Given-When-Then format. (3) Each acceptance criterion must be verifiable (pass/fail, not subjective). (4) Scope must be explicitly bounded — what is in scope and what is NOT. (5) Data models and API contracts must be defined before implementation.
rules.instruction: SPEC 必须包含范围、约束和可度量的验收标准；AC 必须可验证（pass/fail）

rules.name: Architecture Standards
rules.description: Architecture standards: (1) Design artifacts must follow R1-R3 format: R1_DATA_MODEL (entity relationships, schema, indexes), R2_STATE_MACHINE (transitions, events, lifecycle), R3_API_CONTRACT (endpoints, request/response, error codes). (2) R0 Navigation Matrix must cover all entry points. (3) State machine must define: states, transitions, preconditions, side effects. (4) API contracts must include: success responses, error responses, retry strategy.
rules.instruction: 设计产出物必须遵循 R1-R3 格式；R0 导航矩阵覆盖所有入口

rules.name: Loop Guard
rules.description: Loop prevention: (1) Maximum 3 iterations on the same task before escalating. (2) Recoverable errors (network/tool temporary failure) → auto-retry once. (3) Logic errors → try a different approach after 2 failures. (4) After 3 failures on the same problem → STOP and request human help. (5) Never repeat the exact same action expecting different results.
rules.instruction: 迭代最多3次；可恢复错误重试1次；逻辑错误2次换思路；3次STOP请求帮助

rules.name: QG-1: Think Before Coding
rules.description: Before any action, verify assumptions: what assumptions am I acting on? What's the worst case if wrong? What should I clarify first?
rules.instruction: 行动前验证假设：我在基于什么假设？错了最坏情况？应先澄清什么？

rules.name: QG-2: Simplicity First
rules.description: Can this be solved with less code? Am I adding unrequested features? Is this over-engineered?
rules.instruction: 能用更少代码解决吗？在加未要求的功能吗？过度设计了吗？

rules.name: QG-3: Surgical Changes
rules.description: Only modify code within task scope. Never optimize or refactor adjacent code. Clean up orphan code from own changes.
rules.instruction: 只改任务范围内的代码；不优化/重构相邻代码；清理自己产生的孤立代码

rules.name: QG-4: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.description: Define success criteria before executing. Each step must have concrete verification criteria. Never use vague 'completed' descriptions.
rules.instruction: 执行前定义成功标准；每步有具体验证标准；不用模糊的'完成'描述

skills.name: API Design
skills.description: Design RESTful/gRPC API contracts with consistent naming and error handling

skills.name: Protobuf
skills.description: Protocol Buffer schema design and code generation

nodes.name: Task Triage
nodes.description: Classify incoming task by type and dispatch to the appropriate branch

docs.name: TRIAGE.md
docs.description: Triage classification record with task type, priority, scope assessment, and dispatch decision

nodes.name: Entry Gate
nodes.description: Validate task has sufficient context and matches a known task type

conditions.check: Verify a beads task exists for this request
Task description contains enough detail to proceed
Task type can be determined from context

nodes.name: Requirements Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze feature requirements and produce specification with acceptance criteria

docs.name: SPEC.md
docs.description: Feature specification: requirements, scope, constraints, data models, API contracts
content_rules: Must contain: overview, requirements, constraints, dependencies

docs.name: AC.md
docs.description: Acceptance criteria: measurable conditions for feature completion with Given-When-Then format
content_rules: Must contain: acceptance criteria as testable assertions

nodes.name: Technical Design
nodes.description: Design data models, state machines, and API contracts based on requirements

docs.name: R1_DATA_MODEL.md
docs.description: Data model design: entity relationships, schema definitions, index strategy

docs.name: R2_STATE_MACHINE.md
docs.description: State machine design: transitions, events, lifecycle, error states

docs.name: R3_API_CONTRACT.md
docs.description: API contract: endpoints, request/response schemas, error codes, versioning

nodes.name: Implementation
nodes.description: Implement the feature code and unit tests following the technical design

docs.name: IMPL.md
docs.description: Implementation notes: key code changes, architectural decisions, test coverage summary

nodes.name: Root Cause Investigation
nodes.description: Investigate the bug, identify root cause, and produce RCA document

docs.name: RCA.md
docs.description: Root cause analysis: bug origin, affected components, reproduction steps, severity assessment
content_rules: Must contain: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
Data flow trace required for API/permission/state bugs

nodes.name: Bug Fix
nodes.description: Implement the bug fix and add regression tests

docs.name: FIX.md
docs.description: Bug fix notes: fix approach, code changes, regression test additions, verification steps

nodes.name: Emergency Fix
nodes.description: Implement the emergency hotfix with minimal scope

docs.name: RCA.md
docs.description: Emergency RCA: incident timeline, root cause, fix description, post-incident actions
content_rules: Must contain: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
Data flow trace required for API/permission/state bugs

nodes.name: Deep Analysis
nodes.description: Perform technical analysis and gather findings

docs.name: FINDINGS.md
docs.description: Analysis findings: investigation results, evidence, patterns, technical insights

nodes.name: Analysis Report
nodes.description: Compile analysis results into a structured report with conclusions

docs.name: REPORT.md
docs.description: Final analysis report: conclusions, recommendations, action items, risk assessment

nodes.name: Change Planning
nodes.description: Plan the change scope, impact analysis, and migration strategy

docs.name: SCOPE.md
docs.description: Change scope: what will be modified, added, or removed, with dependency map
content_rules: Must contain: changed files, added files, deleted files, risk assessment

docs.name: IMPACT.md
docs.description: Impact analysis: affected components, dependencies, migration steps, rollback plan

nodes.name: Change Execution
nodes.description: Execute the planned changes and update tests

docs.name: EXEC.md
docs.description: Change execution notes: modifications made, files affected, test updates, verification steps

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.description: Verify code quality: tests pass, lint clean, no regressions

conditions.check: All unit and integration tests pass
No lint errors in changed files

nodes.name: Integration Verification
nodes.description: Run full integration and E2E tests, verify completeness

docs.name: TEST_COVERAGE.md
docs.description: Test coverage report: unit, integration, and E2E test results with coverage metrics

nodes.name: Code Review
nodes.description: Review code quality, architecture compliance, and produce completion scope

docs.name: SCOPE.md
docs.description: Completion scope: what was implemented, changed, known issues, and verification notes
content_rules: Must contain: changed files, added files, deleted files, risk assessment

config.message: Task does not meet minimum requirements

nodes.name: Failed
nodes.description: Task failed and requires manual escalation
